verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־ תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־ תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mā·lāḵ gê·’ūṯ lā·ḇêš lā·ḇêš Yah·weh ‘ōz hiṯ·’az·zār ’ap̄- tik·kō·wn tê·ḇêl bal- tim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: The LORD reigns He is robed in majesty the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength The world indeed is firmly established it cannot be moved
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR reina; está vestido de majestade. O SENHOR se revestiu e cingiu de poder; o mundo também está firmado, e não poderá vacilar.

verses.literal: Your throne was established long ago You are from all eternity
verses.literalPt: O teu trono está firme desde então; tu és desde a eternidade.

verses.original: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nā·śə·’ū nə·hā·rō·wṯ Yah·weh nā·śə·’ū nə·hā·rō·wṯ qō·w·lām yiś·’ū nə·hā·rō·wṯ dā·ḵə·yām
verses.literal: The floodwaters have risen O LORD the rivers have raised their voice the seas lift up their pounding waves
verses.literalPt: Os rios levantam, ó SENHOR, os rios levantam o seu ruído, os rios levantam as suas ondas.

verses.original: מִקֹּל֨וֹת׀ מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־ יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·lō·wṯ ma·yim rab·bîm ’ad·dî·rîm miš·bə·rê- yām ’ad·dîr bam·mā·rō·wm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Above the roar of many waters the mighty breakers of the sea the LORD on high is majestic
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR nas alturas é mais poderoso do que o ruído das grandes águas e do que as grandes ondas do mar.

verses.original: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ׀ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ḏō·ṯe·ḵā ne·’em·nū mə·’ōḏ lə·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā na·’ă·wāh- qō·ḏeš Yah·weh lə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Your testimonies are fully confirmed holiness adorns Your house O LORD for all the days to come
verses.literalPt: Mui fiéis são os teus testemunhos; a santidade convém à tua casa, SENHOR, para sempre.
